defmodule ArchiveApi.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:urlencoded, :multipart],
    pass: ["*/*"],
    length: 10_000_000
  plug :dispatch

  @max_upload_size 10_000_000
  @extraction_dir "/tmp/archive_extractions"
  @allowed_extensions ~w(.zip .gz .tar.gz)

  post "/api/v1/archives/analyze" do
    with {:ok, upload} <- validate_upload(conn),
         {:ok, task_id} <- schedule_extraction(upload) do
      conn
      |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
      |> send_resp(202, Jason.encode!(%{task_id: task_id, status: "processing"}))
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/archives/:task_id/status" do
    case ArchiveApi.TaskRegistry.get_status(task_id) do
      {:ok, status} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(status))
      :not_found ->
        send_resp(conn, 404, "")
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end

  defp validate_upload(conn) do
    case conn.params do
      %{"archive" => %Plug.Upload{} = upload} ->
        compressed_size = File.stat!(upload.path).size
        ext = Path.extname(upload.filename)
        cond do
          compressed_size > @max_upload_size ->
            {:error, "File too large"}
          ext not in @allowed_extensions ->
            {:error, "Invalid file type"}
          true ->
            {:ok, upload}
        end
      _ ->
        {:error, "Missing archive parameter"}
    end
  end

  defp schedule_extraction(upload) do
    task_id = Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16), case: :lower)
    Task.async(fn -> ArchiveApi.Extractor.process(task_id, upload) end)
    {:ok, task_id}
  end
end

defmodule ArchiveApi.Extractor do
  require Logger

  @extraction_base "/tmp/archive_extractions"
  @max_entries 1000
  @max_total_ratio 100

  def process(task_id, upload) do
    dest = Path.join(@extraction_base, task_id)
    File.mkdir_p!(dest)
    ArchiveApi.TaskRegistry.update(task_id, %{status: "extracting"})

    try do
      result = extract_with_limits(upload.path, dest, upload.filename)
      ArchiveApi.TaskRegistry.update(task_id, %{status: "complete", result: result})
    rescue
      e ->
        Logger.error("Extraction failed: #{inspect(e)}")
        ArchiveApi.TaskRegistry.update(task_id, %{status: "failed", error: inspect(e)})
    after
      File.rm_rf(dest)
    end
  end

  defp extract_with_limits(archive_path, dest, filename) do
    compressed_size = File.stat!(archive_path).size
    max_decompressed = compute_max_decompressed(compressed_size)

    case Path.extname(filename) do
      ".zip" -> extract_zip(archive_path, dest, max_decompressed)
      ".gz" -> extract_gzip(archive_path, dest, max_decompressed)
      _ -> {:error, "Unsupported format"}
    end
  end

  defp compute_max_decompressed(compressed_size) do
    # Allow up to max_total_ratio times the compressed size
    compressed_size * @max_total_ratio
  end

  defp extract_zip(archive_path, dest, max_decompressed) do
    {:ok, zip_handle} = :zip.zip_open(String.to_charlist(archive_path), [:memory])
    {:ok, file_list} = :zip.zip_list_dir(zip_handle)

    entries = file_list
    |> Enum.filter(fn
      {:zip_file, _, _, _, _, _} -> true
      _ -> false
    end)

    if length(entries) > @max_entries do
      :zip.zip_close(zip_handle)
      raise "Too many entries in archive"
    end

    # Process entries concurrently with streaming decompression
    total_extracted = extract_entries_concurrent(zip_handle, entries, dest, max_decompressed)
    :zip.zip_close(zip_handle)
    %{files_extracted: length(entries), total_bytes: total_extracted}
  end

  defp extract_entries_concurrent(zip_handle, entries, dest, max_decompressed) do
    # Use a shared counter via process dictionary for cross-task tracking
    counter_ref = :atomics.new(1, signed: false)

    tasks = entries
    |> Enum.take(@max_entries)
    |> Enum.map(fn {:zip_file, name, _info, _comment, _offset, _comp_size} ->
      Task.async(fn ->
        extract_single_entry(zip_handle, name, dest, max_decompressed, counter_ref)
      end)
    end)

    results = Task.await_many(tasks, 30_000)
    :atomics.get(counter_ref, 1)
  end

  defp extract_single_entry(zip_handle, name, dest, max_decompressed, counter_ref) do
    safe_name = sanitize_path(to_string(name))
    output_path = Path.join(dest, safe_name)

    # Ensure no path traversal
    unless String.starts_with?(Path.expand(output_path), Path.expand(dest)) do
      raise "Path traversal detected"
    end

    File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(output_path))

    case :zip.zip_get(name, zip_handle, [:memory]) do
      {:ok, {_, content}} ->
        entry_size = byte_size(content)
        current = :atomics.add_get(counter_ref, 1, entry_size)

        # Check AFTER adding — race window between concurrent tasks
        # Each task checks independently but the atomic add already committed
        if current <= max_decompressed do
          File.write!(output_path, content)
          entry_size
        else
          # Rollback the counter but content was already fully decompressed in memory
          :atomics.sub(counter_ref, 1, entry_size)
          raise "Decompression limit exceeded"
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Failed to extract #{name}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        0
    end
  end

  defp extract_gzip(archive_path, dest, max_decompressed) do
    output_name = Path.basename(archive_path, ".gz")
    output_path = Path.join(dest, sanitize_path(output_name))

    archive_path
    |> File.stream!([], 65_536)
    |> StreamGzip.decompress()
    |> Stream.transform(0, fn chunk, acc ->
      new_acc = acc + byte_size(chunk)
      if new_acc > max_decompressed do
        {:halt, acc}
      else
        {[chunk], new_acc}
      end
    end)
    |> Stream.into(File.stream!(output_path))
    |> Stream.run()

    %{files_extracted: 1, total_bytes: File.stat!(output_path).size}
  end

  defp sanitize_path(path) do
    path
    |> String.replace("..", "")
    |> String.replace(~r/^[\/\\]+/, "")
    |> String.trim()
  end
end

defmodule ArchiveApi.TaskRegistry do
  use Agent

  def start_link(_opts) do
    Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def update(task_id, status) do
    Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn state ->
      Map.put(state, task_id, status)
    end)
  end

  def get_status(task_id) do
    Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn state ->
      case Map.get(state, task_id) do
        nil -> :not_found
        status -> {:ok, status}
      end
    end)
  end
end
